key_difference: (D) adds a separate decodeForLocalFile() that re-decodes UTF-8 runs and checks only percent-encoded bytes, whereas (B) adds a flag to the existing decode(), treats any decoded byte >= 0x80 as invalid (valid UTF-8 is already stored as UTF-16), and on Windows also rejects literal backslashes, which QUrl stores in decoded form; (D) misses that case, so an unsafe '\' can reach a local path.
